text:
Priya: Quick strike sync — QuickStrike (partner) just confirmed marketplace listing + webinar. Need to lock webinar date/time, benchmark headline for the launch post, LP CTA, and inbound lead routing. Who can own what?

Marco: I can own webinar logistics (zoom registration, recording, slides). Propose Tue Oct 10 11am PT — works?

Jen: Sounds good. For the blog/benchmark narrative we need concrete metrics: p95 latency, throughput (tokens/s or reqs/s), and estimated per-token cost. Also want 2-3 headline options.

Oscar: Eng-ML here — can run a quick matrix on our side. I can deliver p50/p95, tokens/sec at 1k/2k context, and quantized vs FP16 cost delta by EOD Thu. Need the exact model variant QuickStrike will use.

Maya: Partner ask: co-branded slide deck (templates + logos) by Monday so their comms team can QA. Also they'd like a joint blog quote from their PM (Tomas).

Sam: Question on inbound leads: do we route marketplace leads into an existing SFDC campaign or create QuickStrike-Launch campaign? Also need the triage flow — AE vs SDR?

Leah: Recommend: create SFDC campaign "QS-Launch-2026", tag all marketplace form fills with that campaign + source=marketplace. Route initial leads to partner-sdr queue for 48hrs, then handoff to owning AE. Also add nurture drip 3-email cadence.

Priya: OK Leah — can you draft the lead routing playbook? Sam — can you confirm SDR owner?

Sam: I'll assign to @partner-sdr (Riley team) and confirm headcount. Also need the lead enrichment fields from the marketplace payload — email, company, role, intent score.

Jen: Draft headline ideas: 1) "QuickStrike + Redwood: Faster, Cheaper LLM Inference for Customer Support" 2) "How QuickStrike cut inference costs 45% with Redwood" 3) "Benchmark: Serving QuickStrike at 98ms p95 with 3x throughput" — Oscar, can you validate numbers to avoid overclaiming?

Oscar: Will validate. Quick note: the 98ms p95 claim depends on sequence length and model variant; I can provide bounded headline: "~100ms p95 on common ticket-length prompts" if you want safe copy.

Maya: Partner prefers the stronger headline but will accept a parenthetical qualifier. Also sending logo files now — expect them in #assets channel.

PartnerBot: Partner QuickStrike updated: speaker Tomas confirmed; co-branded deck request acknowledged. (automated)

Marco: Webinar format proposal: 30min demo (Priya + Tomas) + 20min live Q&A + 10min quick benchmark walkthrough (Oscar). We should keep the demo focused on integration patterns and cost breakdown.

Priya: Agree. Action items: Marco owns webinar logistics; Oscar owns benchmark numbers + one slide; Jen owns blog draft and headline pull; Leah owns SFDC campaign + routing doc; Maya owns partner assets + speaker comms; Sam confirms SDR owner. Target: all assets ready by Monday EOD for review.

Jen: I'll put a draft blog outline in Google Drive and ping everyone. Proposed UTM for links: `?utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=quickstrike_launch`

Oscar: Quick ask for data collection: please give me sample prompt lengths and a representative traffic shape (percentiles). That helps me pick batching and sequence configs.

Maya: Sending example traffic CSV and demo prompts to Oscar now.

Priya: Love it. If we keep timelines, partner launch comms go out the week of Oct 15. Short followups: everyone add any blockers before EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

Marco: Added calendar hold for Oct 10.

Sam: Confirmed SDR assignment — Riley team.

Leah: Drafted SFDC campaign and shared the routing doc in this thread (link: https://drive.redwood/workspace/qs-launch-routing).

Jen: Posted initial blog outline: https://drive.redwood/docs/qs-launch-outline — comments welcome.

Priya: Thanks all — will consolidate and send a one-pager for partner and our comms team by tomorrow morning.
